# llm.music/v1

A model makes music from a prompt (and lyrics). It takes a while, so it's a job. Every call names its model as `provider/model`: a provider the app's admins added in Settings → LLM, a slash, and
that provider's own id for the model. Shared types (`File`, `Usage`, `ModelInfo`, `Job`, the errors) are in
[`pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/blob/main/ext/contracts/llm/llm.go).

A wire contract at `/api/_c/llm.music/v1` ([music.go](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/blob/main/ext/contracts/llm/music/v1/music.go)), one provider. The
[llm](/docs/extensions/llm/extension) extension provides it, over Vultr, Cloudflare Workers AI, OpenRouter and any
OpenAI-compatible API.

## Use

In page code it's `$llm.music` (bound by the llm extension):

```js
const job = await $llm.music.createAsync({ model: "vultr/ace-step-1.5", prompt: "gentle lullaby", seconds: 60, wait: "5m" })
if (job.status === "done") record.set("music", $llm.file(job.files[0]))
```

Over HTTP (a superuser, or a token with the scope shown):

| Operation | HTTP | Body | Token scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| Create | `POST /api/_c/llm.music/v1/create` | `{"model": "...", "prompt": "...", "lyrics": "", "seconds": 60, "wait": ""}` | `llm` |
| Get | `POST /api/_c/llm.music/v1/get` | `{"id": "vultr:music_..."}` | `llm:read` |
| Content | `POST /api/_c/llm.music/v1/content` | `{"id": "...", "index": 0}` | `llm:read` |
| Models | `GET /api/_c/llm.music/v1/models` | `?provider=` (optional) | `llm:read` |

`create` and `get` answer a job: `{"id", "status" (queued, running, done, failed), "progress", "files", "outputs",
"error", "model", "usage"}`. With `wait` (`"5m"`) `create` returns once the job stops, its files included; without it,
at once. The id carries the provider (`vultr:music_02a2…`), and the provider keeps the job. `content` returns one of a
done job's files.

Errors: `not_configured` (no providers), `unknown_model`, `not_supported`, `provider` (the cloud's own error), `timeout`.

From Go: `musicv1.Contract.Must(app)` (from `pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm/music/v1`).

## Provide

Implement `musicv1.Music` and provide it in `Register` (`musicv1.Contract.Provide(app, impl)`). Route on the
`provider/` prefix, answer `not_supported` for a provider that can't do this kind, `unknown_model` for a missing model
or provider, and `provider` with the cloud's own message (never its key) when the cloud refuses. Fill `model` with the
full `provider/model` that answered, and `usage` with what the provider reports.

## Commands and APIs

Every operation is a REST endpoint, a `pocketone` command and an MCP tool, all generated from the contract and behind the same token scope check and hooks. See [Remote CLI](/docs/features/remote), or the full [CLI](/docs/reference/cli), [Extension APIs](/docs/extensions/apis) and [MCP](/docs/reference/mcp) references.

### create

Starts making music. With Wait it returns once the job is done (or failed), its files included; otherwise at once, to follow with Get.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/llm.music/v1/create` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm music create --model <value> --prompt <value> --lyrics <value> --seconds <n> --wait <value> --options <json>` |
| MCP | `llm_music_create` |
| Token scope | `llm` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | `--model` | string |
| `prompt` | `--prompt` | string |
| `lyrics` | `--lyrics` | string |
| `seconds` | `--seconds` | float |
| `wait` | `--wait` | string |
| `options` | `--options` | json |

### get

Says how a job is going.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/llm.music/v1/get` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm music get --id <value>` |
| MCP | `llm_music_get` |
| Token scope | `llm:read` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `--id` | string |

### content

Fetches one of a done job's files.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/llm.music/v1/content` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm music content --id <value> --index <n>` |
| MCP | `llm_music_content` |
| Token scope | `llm:read` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `--id` | string |
| `index` | `--index` | int |

### models

Lists the music models of every provider in Settings → LLM.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/_c/llm.music/v1/models` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm music models --provider <value>` |
| MCP | `llm_music_models` |
| Token scope | `llm:read` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `--provider` | string |
